shadow_settings.tradeoff: Reduced excess near-camera shadow resolution; body still casts dynamic shadows, fine-fur section does not. Broad performance unmeasured.

repair_notes: Joined shallow separate ear/tail islands into one closed primary skin; kept original 24 bind matrices and bit-identical texture maps.
Initial imports omitted the generated skeleton package on disk; importer now saves and verifies it before saving the mesh.
Early close-ups exposed harsh ear-root colour and mixed head/spine weights; root palette and upper-skull weighting were blended.
Fine-fur shadow removal alone and a directional/local bias-only probe of 1/2 still overflowed. Final clipmap 9 and biases 2/3 eliminated the observed overflow with diagnostics enabled.

Two batch navigation runs failed the old 0.4-second movement snapshot; an isolated run passed. Fixture now waits for observed traversal with a two-second bound, retains the five-centimetre and Playing-screen requirements and records metrics. Final full suite passed.
Smooth-coat capture completes before switching back to the detailed mesh.
verification_scope: Synthetic keyboard/gamepad input, position/camera/action/save fixtures on the real map.
Walking, trotting, ear flop, kitchen head lowering, body sway, lie/get-up, rolling/recovery and live coat switching; 28 gait/attachment checks.
Costume orientation plus root origins checked during tricks and in locked/unlocked two-process LAN; LAN uses null RHI on one machine.
Eight final actual packaged images reviewed. Seasonal captures also passed freshness and dimensions gates.
Original assets, source generators, materials, coat/normal textures, prior packages, Unity and independent preview retained.
